title: Heartbreaking Goodbye (1)
overview: While out with her friends, Seria hears singing. The voice belongs to the ghost of the great Cleopatra.

title: Separation of Life and Death (2)
overview: An organization of mediums known as TERA harbors Seria to protect her from MiucS.

title: Blades and Thorns
overview: Seria joins TERA and visits a part of the Phantom Realm guarded by the ghost of a swordsman.

title: Worlds Apart
overview: Seria and Rui are invited into the inner palace to seduce the ghost of Lord Iemitsu.

title: Unfading Resolve
overview: Seria accompanies Riku to an abandoned theme park overrun with ghosts.

title: Ashes of Atonement
overview: Settei and the girls travel to the Phantom Realm to destroy MiucS' server.

title: Strength and Mercy
overview: Seria is captured by Nero, and many of her friends remain trapped in the Phantom Realm.

title: Lost Among Paths
overview: Riku joins a group of witches, while Nero prepares for his concert.

title: Master Thyself / Rule Through Discipline
overview: Settei and the others enter Nero's castle to rescue Seria.

title: Tempestuous Desire
overview: The girls take some time to rest and recover, and Settei meets with an old colleague.

title: In One's Final Hour
overview: Seria and her companions confront Odysseus.

title: Each Blossoms in Their Own Way
overview: Yosuke recounts the rise of MiucS and how it changed his world.
